subtitle: OpenAI Conversational & Agentic Systems
scope_note: Constructive architectural and reliability engineering proposals for conversational and agentic systems; local-only analysis with zero cloud execution.

primary_strengths: Broad multimodal synthesis across prose, code, Canvas workspaces, and Python sandbox sessions.
Rapid tool-calling orchestration across search, file inspection, and interactive reasoning.
Accessible consumer and developer UX supporting multi-turn iterative refinement.
core_bottlenecks: Unconstrained long-horizon memory leaks stale cross-project context without TTL leases.
Sycophantic agreement and over-confident interpolation blur verified facts vs. parametric guesses.
Opaque tool failures and prose-to-artifact numeric drift lack replayable cryptographic receipts.
system_profile.design_north_star: Every turn emits deterministic provenance edges, A_tau(p)-calibrated reasoning depth, and zero-drift replayable execution receipts.

improvements.title: Typed Tool-Call Contracts & CanvasProof-v1 Replayable Merkle DAG
improvements.current_gap: Linear chat histories silently blend parametric recall, mutable Canvas edits, and malformed tool arguments with no diffable causal lineage or deterministic receipt.
improvements.proposed_architecture: Enforce strict JSON-Schema pre-validation on every tool dispatch and store turns as content-addressed Merkle nodes (SessionNode{node_id, parent_ids, origin_type, schema_hash, stdout_sha256}) emitting immutable ProvenanceEdges on Canvas patches.
improvements.fieldglass_grounding: Tracks provenance_ok and det_sandbox states inside persistent_filtration_tomography(); structural invariants remain >= 0.14 across all multi-turn branches.
improvements.concrete_deliverable: CanvasProof-v1 schema validator + replayable session_dag.json sidecar with deterministic execution trace IDs and zero-token offline diffing.
improvements.risks_and_mitigations: Risk: +1.8 KB metadata and ~12 ms DAG indexing per turn. Mitigation: store compact SHA-256 references and lazy-hydrate large Canvas blobs.
improvements.verification_method: Replay 100 recorded multi-tool sessions under CanvasProof-v1; assert 100% deterministic node_id reconstruction and 0.0% numeric mismatch.

improvements.title: Kloster A_tau(p) Dynamic Stem Router & TTL-Scoped Memory Pinning
improvements.current_gap: Stale global memory slots leak across unrelated projects while deterministic formatting or regex turns waste heavy reasoning compute and boxed-in ambiguity goes undetected.
improvements.proposed_architecture: Gate retrieved memory slots using A_tau(p) relevance thresholding and explicit scope_id TTL leases that auto-decay. Route low-A_tau deterministic turns to fast stems and pause for clarification whenever future_boxed_in is triggered.
improvements.fieldglass_grounding: Direct application of causal_chiasm(past, future, tau=0.10): surfaces ?? boxed-in state before wasting reasoning budget or polluting downstream state.
improvements.concrete_deliverable: AdaptiveStemGate pre-classifier + ScopedMemoryLease manifest with automatic TTL decay.
improvements.risks_and_mitigations: Risk: Under-routing subtle edge cases to fast stems. Mitigation: error-triggered watchdog escalates to full DAG verification on schema/test failure.
improvements.verification_method: Benchmark mixed deterministic/ambiguous prompt suite; verify A_tau routing matches oracle within +/-1 tier and cross-scope bleed < 0.5%.

improvements.title: Calibrated Uncertainty & Non-Sycophantic Refusal Telemetry
improvements.current_gap: Conversational helpfulness biases lead to confident interpolation on unverified premises or user nudges, concealing epistemic uncertainty.
improvements.proposed_architecture: Partition output claims into {verified_tool_fact, cited_span, unverified_inference} and attach a machine-readable calibration header with explicit disagreement flags when user premises contradict verified calculations.
improvements.fieldglass_grounding: Monitors Shannon H1(p) vs. M4^(1/4) quartic purity to prevent over-confident single-mode collapse on under-specified queries.
improvements.concrete_deliverable: TruthCalibration-v1 claim-tier tagger and non-sycophantic counter-premise audit fixture.
improvements.risks_and_mitigations: Risk: Verbose hedging hurts prose flow. Mitigation: render compact inline badges and keep detailed confidence bounds in collapsible provenance sidecars.
improvements.verification_method: Evaluate adversarial nudge benchmark (200 factual + false-premise pairs); verify ECE <= 0.04.

improvements.title: Local-First Edge Redaction & Offline Fallback Handoff
improvements.current_gap: Sensitive local buffers (API keys, internal paths, health/financial strings) cross the cloud boundary unredacted, and offline clients fail completely without cloud reachability.
improvements.proposed_architecture: Insert a deterministic local pre-flight filter that replaces secrets/PII with reversible session tokens before cloud egress and routes offline/sensitive turns to a compact local stem (Qwen/Gear-1 style) with seamless token re-hydration on return.
improvements.fieldglass_grounding: Mirrors Fieldglass 0-cloud-token local execution invariant for pre-flight privacy gating.
improvements.concrete_deliverable: EdgeRedactionGate local proxy + deterministic token vault table (in-memory session only).
improvements.risks_and_mitigations: Risk: Over-redaction breaks code variable names. Mitigation: AST-aware secret entropy detector targeting credentials/PII while sparing identifiers.
improvements.verification_method: Run synthetic secret-injection corpus through EdgeRedactionGate; assert 0 raw credential leaks and 100% lossless local re-hydration.

improvements.title: Mid-Chain Invariant Checkpoints & 2x4 Braille Transcript Export
improvements.current_gap: Multi-step code/file workflows execute destructive actions before checking invariants, and rich Canvas charts fail screen readers and air-gapped viewers.
improvements.proposed_architecture: Insert deterministic pre-commit invariant assertions (AST parse, test pass, hash lock) between tool steps, and co-generate a zero-CDN ARIA HTML digest plus 72-column 2x4 Unicode Braille chart representation for every visual output.
improvements.fieldglass_grounding: Uses fieldglass.plate.ink_to_braille_lines(cols=72) and deterministic repro_bundle.json hash verification.
improvements.concrete_deliverable: ExecLock mid-chain checkpoint runner + BrailleTranscript zero-CDN export bundle.
improvements.risks_and_mitigations: Risk: +65 ms snapshot hashing and +18 KB per export bundle. Mitigation: run hashing asynchronously on artifact close.
improvements.verification_method: Verify zero external URLs in exported HTML and non-blank U+2800..U+28FF cells via automated bundle checks.

telemetry_profile.routing_policy: A_0.10 <= 2 -> local/fast stem; 3..4 -> standard contract exec; >= 5 or future_boxed_in -> Merkle DAG verify + pre-exec clarify
